description: MariaDB database server (official archive.mariadb.org Windows ZIP), run as a normal process — no Windows service.

features.label: Server (mysqld)
features.missingNote: mysqld.exe isn't in this install. Use Repair to reinstall it.

features.label: Database initializer
features.missingNote: The initializer is missing. Use Repair to reinstall it.

features.label: Admin tool (ping/shutdown)
features.missingNote: mariadb-admin.exe is missing. Use Repair to reinstall it.

notes: MariaDB 11.8 LTS Windows x64 ZIP from archive.mariadb.org; SHA256 from downloads.mariadb.org's release data. About 300 MB installed. OpenMind Studio starts it as a normal child process bound to 127.0.0.1 with its data in data/mariadb, logs in logs/mariadb and config in settings/mariadb — nothing is installed as a service and no machine MySQL/MariaDB is used.
